selectionHelp: The session has not confirmed a company and store. Modules are blocked until server authorization.
deniedHelp: Sign in again for a valid session. Typing another code cannot fix authorization.
legendInfo: Operational requires verified flow, persistence, permissions, isolation, audit and restore. A screen alone does not earn this status.
missingNames: The current API does not provide company and store names. Session identifiers were checked, but names are not assumed.
noSwitch: Company or store switching is not available yet. This block is not a selector.
integrationUnknown: No connected source to retrieve integration counts, failures or status.
